data.name: Caressa
data.gender_notes: Caressa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'karao', meaning 'to touch', Caressa represents a delicate, gentle touch. In Christian spirituality, it symbolizes the tender touch of God on the soul. The name Caressa carries the meaning “Delicate, gentle touch” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Caressa usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, gentle touch and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A tender touch from the divine
data.etymology: Caressa belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, gentle touch.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caressa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Caressa' does not have a direct history rooted in known cultures, but we can draw inspiration from the meaning of its origin, 'karao', which encourages a sense of touch and connection. This can manifest into various aspects of culture, like tender affection between people, nurturing the arts, and showing compassion towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, the name 'Caressa' holds a deeper meaning as it signifies the loving touch of God on the soul. Like a gentle breeze, His presence brings comfort, healing, and growth. The name serves as a reminder of the ultimate connection we can have with our Creator and the unending grace He extends to us.
